**Instagram Habits**

By Astou, Kalia, & Cassey

**Description**: 
We want to research how much time we spend on Instagram and how that affects our daily lives. We want to observe what we consume and how much of it we consume. 

**Questions**:
How much time are we spending on Instagram? 
What content are we consuming on Instagram?
How is it affecting our daily lives? Attention span, productivity, etc. 

**Reason/Inspiration**:
We wanted to see how social media affects our daily lives. We want to know the exact amount of time we are dedicating to social media (scrolling). We want to see what we are consuming. And once we measure how these habits are impacting our lives, we want to be able to learn how we can improve our wellbeing. Is social media hurting or helping us?
